name: Quick Fox
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot neck; Price 6,000 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This tattoo is most often rendered with a fox, resting on the chest and shoulders.

The tattoo’s owner gains the following continual benefits:

+2 enhancement bonus to Initiative
+4 bonus to all Perception checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Tattoo, cat’s grace, owl’s wisdom; Cost 3,000 gp.
